_comment: Exercises botl.c fldname_to_bl_indx() (2219-2253) and match_str2conditionbitmask() (3170-3206) through parse_status_hl1()/parse_status_hl2() and parse_condition(): each compares names with fuzzymatch(..., " -_", TRUE), which skips spaces, hyphens and underscores but not a tab or form feed.
